main_text.head: Cap. 31. De horistîcis.
main_text.p: Formatur á 2 futuro actívo, mutan-do ᾳ in α, & assumendo initium horistici 1. Sic á πλήγῳ fit πέπληγα percussi, á φεύδω πέφευδα confideravi.
Atticæ reduplicationes hîc quo-que locum habent:
ἀρῶ apto, ἀρηγα, poeticé ἠρηγα & ἀρηγα, aptatus sum, congruo.
ἔδω edo, ἔδηδα: unde ἐδηδώς qui comedit. fic ἐλεύθω venio, ἐλήλυθα.
ὄλλω sive ὀλέω perdo, ὄλωλα: unde compos. ἀπόλωλα perii.
ὁρῶ concito, ὁρωρα, & poeticé ὠρωρα. at οἴγω aperio, ἔωγα pro ὤγα: unde compos. ἀνέωγα, & incremento triplici ἀνεώγα.
ἔπω, ἔφπα pro εἶπα, dico, dixi.

page.notes: Greek and accented forms are transcribed approximately from the scan; the marginal mark "q" and "iiij" at the foot is a signature. Some accents and breathings are doubtful.
